title: Personal Training Packages: the club-membership signing bonus at activation
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states the club-membership basis for a signing-bonus session grant at activation.

## Rule
At activation, a package is credited a signing bonus of 2 additional sessions where the member's own club membership is active and that membership's own personal-training discount percentage is at least 10; where no active club membership is held, or its discount percentage falls below 10, no signing bonus is credited.

## Points of judgement
- What is held: an active club membership whose own personal-training discount percentage is at least 10.
- What value it contributes: qualification for the signing bonus (a yes/no determination, not a scaled amount).
- What effect it has: exactly 2 additional sessions are credited when the membership qualifies; no partial or scaled bonus is ever credited.
A membership whose personal-training discount percentage is exactly 10 qualifies, since the requirement is a minimum rather than a strict excess; a membership whose percentage is 9 does not qualify. A member with no active club membership at all does not qualify, regardless of any discount percentage a lapsed or inactive membership might otherwise carry.
